force_cloud.description: Kill switch. true sends every AI task to the cloud (use if the on-device model misbehaves).

show_hud.description: Show the Hybrid HUD counter in the app.

on_device_tasks.description: Tasks that run on-device first. Valid: liveCorrect, explain, grade, classify, deepDive, chat. Tasks left out run in the cloud first.

max_on_device_chars.description: Per task: inputs longer than this many characters skip the on-device model and go to the cloud.
